notes: Reference screenshots and personal profile images are not distributed.
Human profile images/names are supplied by the platform; generated character avatars are for BOTs.
Card numerals and UI instructions remain DOM text; home logo is decorative artwork with accessible title.
Background movement is automatic and has no in-game motion setting.
Normal cards compose the same canonical mascot image files used by BOT avatars over a character-free shared frame; characters are not regenerated per numeric value.
Kumomaru uses the original white/pale-lavender cloud asset, the cat and bunny retain their original assets, and Hoshimochi uses the cream-gold five-point star asset.
Approved mapping: -10 and -5 use cloud; 0 uses cat; values 1 through 5 contain exactly that many bunnies; 10, 15 and 20 contain exactly that many stars in rows of five.
Card numerals, rules and frames stay stationary while character-specific layers animate; a separate diagonal white gloss sweep is shared across cards.
Face-down cards do not create numeric character compositions. Duplicate copies of each public numeric value share the same layout.
The decorative home hero is a separate illustration, not a source of BOT or card sprites. Actual iOS and GRAVITY rendering, motion smoothness and audible output require device verification.
